interpretation: Exact rather than linear scoring reduces development profile nRMSE from1.8168 to0.7336, but complete-category accuracy stays25%.
The linearization error is substantial on this fixed library; remaining exact calibration-to-evaluation error and near ties can still change the leading category.
This does not isolate template effects from word/tokenization effects, since both differ between calibration and evaluation.
Every predicted category remains lowercase while19/64 measured categories are uppercase. All64 actual updates remain above the original effect floor.
All original methods, groups, difficult cases and uncertainty are retained. Development comparisons are not confirmation.
decision: Reject v5 as the selected predictor. Do not invoke its conditional held-out preparer. Preserve the original reserved/fresh grids and success criteria. Further method development must address transfer or representation, not change the threshold or reuse a favorable subgroup.
scope: Native one-step Qwen3-14B rank16 updates; finite reference-answer loss preference. V5 uses extra pinned-base and task-library access and is not a trained LoRAcle checkpoint.
